items.title: John Paulson says we are in the early stages of a long-term bull market for gold
items.summary: He said demand for bullion continues to broaden, led by central banks that have been adding to their reserves alongside growing private-sector interest.

items.title: Kalshi launches election hub for prediction markets ahead of midterms

items.title: Trump plans generic drug tariffs from 2028 with two-year delay testing U.S. onshoring push
items.summary: The latest tariff salvo underscored Trump's goal of reshoring low-cost drug production, but displacing established suppliers like India won't be easy.

items.title: The bull market faces higher likelihood of a Fed rate hike as Iran crisis intensifies

items.title: ServiceNow’s stock rises as earnings show momentum in cybersecurity

items.title: IBM just cut its outlook, but not by as much as investors feared
items.summary: IBM’s official earnings report comes after a bruising profit warning last week.

items.title: ‘I have a $2,000 deductible’: I reported a cracked windshield on my Hertz rental car. Can they charge me?
items.summary: “I never heard a rock hit the windshield.”

items.title: I want to transfer $17,000 in credit-card debt. Why did Wells Fargo offer me only a $4,000 credit limit?
items.summary: “I asked why the limit was so low, but they couldn’t give me an explanation.”

items.title: My second husband and I have kids from previous relationships. Should my house go to him or my children if I die first?
items.summary: “We live in a house that I purchased entirely with money I had before we were married.”
